name: AbraSilver Resource Corp.
description: AbraSilver Resource Corp. is a silver-gold developer focused on its 100%-owned Diablillos Project in Salta, Argentina. The project hosts a large indicated resource of 73.1 Mt grading 79 g/t Ag and 0.66 g/t Au, and received key environmental approvals from Salta authorities in 2026. The company is advancing Diablillos toward production under Argentina's Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI) and recently expanded its land position through adjacent property acquisitions.
